info.name: Matrimony Payments API (In-App Purchase)
info.description:
Complete payment integration endpoints for Frontend Developers (Flutter iOS & Android):

1. Payment Gateway Configuration
2. Packages & Plan List
3. Apple In-App Purchase (StoreKit 2 / Receipt Verification)
4. Google Play In-App Purchase (Android Publisher API) + failed / cancelled purchase reporting
5. Webhook (Apple App Store Server Notifications)

request.description: Public endpoint. Returns the In-App Purchase platform flags (Google Play / Apple) the app should use for checkout.
Returns active package plans with credit counts, price, and both `googlePlayProductId` and `appleProductId`.

response.name: Example Response

request.description: Call from iOS after in_app_purchase completes. Verifies the Apple StoreKit 2 JWS token or base64 receipt with Apple, activates credits atomically.

response.name: Success (200 OK)

item.name: 04. Android - Verify Google Play In-App Purchase

request.description: Call from Android after Google Play Billing completes. Verifies purchase directly with Google Android Publisher API, acknowledges/consumes it, and awards credits.

response.name: Success (200 OK)

item.name: 05. Android - Report Failed / Cancelled Google Play Purchase

request.description: Call when the Google Play purchase did NOT succeed on the device (user closed the payment sheet, card declined, billing unavailable, ...). Records a FAILED transaction for the admin panel; no credits are added. reason: "CANCELLED" (user cancelled) or "FAILED" (default). purchaseToken / orderId are optional. If the purchaseToken was already verified, the report is ignored and status COMPLETED is returned.

response.name: 200 - Cancelled by user
